item.title: 0.4.0-preview.38
item.description:
## Clocky 0.4.0
- **Copy a proposal.** The panel's Copy row now has three choices: the times as before, the same as a question to send ("How about Tue, Oct 6 at 09:00 Miami · 10:00 Buenos Aires, for 30 min?"), or the next three times that suit everyone, as a list to choose from. - **A warning before the clocks change.** In the two weeks before one of your cities, or you, changes clocks and another does not, the panel says what the gap will become. Looking at a date beyond the change, it says why the gap is not the usual one. - **See what a busy block is.** Click one of your events on your bar, or the count under it, for its title, time and calendar. - **Send a time from another app.** Select text such as "3pm ET Thursday" anywhere, then choose Services › Show Time in Clocky. - **The menu-bar icon tells the time.** Its hands show your real time, and the time you are looking at while the panel is open. The date icon is now Clocky's own page. With "Show when I'm busy" on, the folded corner fills in during the ten minutes before your next event. - **Fixed: the icon did nothing when clicked** after Clocky had been started at login or by an update, until it was opened some other way.

## Clocky 0.3.3
- **Fixed: the icon did nothing when clicked** after Clocky had been started at login or by an update, until it was opened some other way.

item.title: 0.4.0-preview.34
item.description:
## Clocky 0.4.0
Notes for this version are written as it takes shape.

## Clocky 0.3.2
- **Preview versions.** Settings › General has a new switch, "Receive preview versions". Turn it on to get new versions a few days before everyone else, and help find their rough edges.

## Clocky 0.3.1
- **Settings › General fits its window.** With a mouse connected it showed a scroll bar; it no longer does.

## Clocky 0.3.0
- **Paste a time as someone wrote it.** A field at the top of the panel reads "3pm ET Thursday", "tomorrow 10:30 Tokyo time" or "jueves 15hs" and moves every city there. Press Return, use the paste button, or press ⌘V with the panel open. - **Clocky updates itself.** It checks for a new version about once a day and offers it in the panel. Settings › General has the switch and a Check Now button. - **A lighter menu-bar icon**, drawn as an outline. - **An app icon that follows macOS 26's icon styles**: dark, tinted and clear.
